# LowPassSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("LowPassSoundEffect")`

Lets the low notes through and takes the high ones away: under water, behind a door, a paused game.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Cutoff` | `number` | `2000` | read/write | The frequency above which sound is taken away, in hertz. |
| `Resonance` | `number` | `0.707` | read/write | How much the notes right at the cutoff are raised, 0.1 to 10: 0.707 is flat, more whistles. |
